title: TSE registers over 50,000 reports of irregular campaigning in 2026 election
seoTitle: TSE receives 51k reports of illegal campaigning
subtitle: The Pardal app has already received 51,395 reports since the start of the electoral race
excerpt: Since the start of the 2026 election campaign, the TSE has received 51,395 reports of irregular campaigning via the Pardal app.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Since the start of the 2026 general election campaign, the Electoral Justice system has already received 51,395 reports of irregular campaigning through the Pardal app, an electronic system created by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to receive and log these occurrences.

How the Pardal app works

Pardal allows any citizen to submit information regarding potential violations of electoral laws, such as the misuse of public property, the dissemination of prohibited content, or other forms of campaigning that violate current regulations. Each report is cataloged and forwarded to the competent authorities for review.

Impact of the reports

The volume of registered complaints highlights the vigilance of the electorate and the TSE's role in monitoring the campaign. The accumulated total of 51,395 reports demonstrates the effective use of this digital tool to monitor the compliance of election campaigning throughout the electoral process.

With information from Agência Brasil.
